note: Montague County publishes no zoning district layer; its GIS is a paid/subscription appraisal map. Nocona has zoning in its code (Chapter 14) but no queryable zoning service found. City of Bowie's public ArcGIS server has only a parcel layer (Property_Web/MapServer/11) with a ZONE_CODE1 attribute, covering Bowie only; a validation at the county sample point (near Nocona) returned 0 districts.
